card.name: Inside names and phone numbers
card.fires_on: Partway through rare proper names (plant species, surnames) and on digits inside phone numbers or catalog codes. Also fires on 'kicked' in the idiom 'kicked the bucket'.

modes.description: The verb in the phrase kicked the bucket.
